description_en: Queries the error logs of an instance within a specified time range
description_zh: 该接口查询实例某段时间内的错误日志
name: DescribeErrorLogs

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC)
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The end time must be later than the start time, and the interval between the start time and end time must be less than 31 days. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，大于查询开始时间，与查询开始时间间隔小于31天。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 30 to 100. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值：30~100。默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number. Valid values: any integer greater than 0 that does not exceed the maximum value of Integer.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number
